## Purpose

Describe the claim or defect this change addresses and link the issue.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover changed behaviour.
- [ ] `bin/check` passes locally.
- [ ] Methodology or schema changes are versioned.
- [ ] Generated artifacts include provenance and checksums.
- [ ] No credentials, seeds, personal data, or private infrastructure details are included.

## Lifecycle state

State what is implemented, verified, externally gated, or deliberately deferred.

## Conflicts and limitations

Disclose relevant conflicts, assumptions, exclusions, and unresolved uncertainty.
